consumer_rules: Join on site_id only; site_name is display text.
MATLAB refuses feasibility claims when capacity_basis is not verified_utility/verified_facility.
Excel/Tableau/presentation quote contract values; no re-derivation.
Any schema change bumps contract_version; consumers assert the major version.

engine_note: Every value in this contract was produced by the Python package. Real MathWorks MATLAB has executed this project's model, but only against a SYNTHETIC fixture -- it has never seen the real sites. GNU Octave is not MATLAB. No number here may be attributed to either.

caveat_text.capacity_placeholder: Electrical capacity is a PLACEHOLDER at all 12 sites. Nobody has confirmed the service could support chargers. This is not evidence of electrical feasibility, and the fail-closed guard refuses to emit a feasibility claim from it.
caveat_text.demand_modelled: Demand is MODELLED, not measured. No charging has been observed at any of these sites; the figures come from benchmark assumptions applied to site characteristics.
caveat_text.wait_simulated: Waits are simulated from modelled demand, never observed. The p50 and p90 are 0.0 at every site because simulated utilisation runs 6-20%.
caveat_text.screening_only: A screening-class planning output for comparing sites. It cannot approve, permit or fund anything, and it is not an engineering design.
caveat_text.cost_screening_class: Screening-class cost estimate for COMPARISON between options. Never a budget, never a quote, never a bid.
caveat_text.emissions_factor: Grid emissions factor: EPA eGRID2023 Rev 2 (data year 2023, released 2025-06-12), SRVC subregion, total output emission rate CO2e, 596.3 lb CO2e/MWh, vintage eGRID2023r2, accessed 2026-07-19.
caveat_text.trigger_policy_proposed: The expansion-trigger policy is PROPOSED configuration, not adopted municipal policy, and every evaluation says so.
caveat_text.confidence_from_typed_provenance: Data confidence is derived only from typed provenance fields -- source class, verification status and staleness. Prose in a notes field cannot change it.
